name: Behold: A Man!
source:
BEHOLD: A MAN! is a short kinetic novel made for O2A2 VN Jam Queer Edition. It contains talk of the human form in a kinda... weird way. It's not explicit in any way, just odd but- hopefully- funny!

[From [url=https://chezforshire.itch.io/behold-a-man]Itch.io[/url]]
